name: ChartArea
description: Represents the chart area of a chart.
remarks: The chart area includes everything, including the plot area. However, the plot area has its own fill, so filling the plot area does not fill the chart area. For information about formatting the plot area, see the PlotArea object. Use the ChartArea property of the Chart object to return the ChartArea object.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns a String value that represents the name of the object.

properties.name: Shadow
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean value that determines if the object has a shadow.

properties.name: Height
properties.description: Returns or sets a Double value that represents the height, in points, of the object.

properties.name: Left
properties.description: Returns or sets a Double value that represents the distance, in points, from the left edge of the object to the left edge of column A (on a worksheet) or the left edge of the chart area (on a chart).

properties.name: Top
properties.description: Returns a Double value that represents the distance, in points, from the top edge of the object to the top of row 1 (on a worksheet) or the top of the chart area (on a chart).

properties.name: Width
properties.description: Returns or sets a Double value that represents the width, in points, of the object.

properties.name: RoundedCorners
properties.description: True if the chart area of the chart has rounded corners. Read/write Boolean.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies the object to the Clipboard.

methods.name: ClearFormats
methods.description: Clears the formatting of the object.

methods.name: ClearContents
methods.description: Clears the data from a chart but leaves the formatting.
